;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015-present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**Fighters of the [[Southern Movement]] capture the port city of [[Aden]] from forces loyal to the internationally recognized [[President of Yemen]] [[Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/southern-yemen-separatists-seize-government-camps-aden-190810121858754.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Libyan Civil War]]
**A [[car bomb]] goes off in [[Benghazi]], killing three members of the [[United Nations Support Mission in Libya]] and two other mission members, and wounding dozens of civilians. [https://amp.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/10/two-un-staff-killed-in-benghazi-car-bombing (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Bærum mosque shooting]]
**A man in [[Bærum]], [[Norway]], opens fire in Al Noor Islamic Centre, injuring a congregant. A woman was found dead at the house of the suspect. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49311482 (BBC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli forces]] shoot dead four [[Palestinian militant]]s near the border with [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], the Israeli military say. Israel Defense Forces say the men were armed with assault rifles, anti-tank missiles and hand grenades. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/10/palestinian-militants-killed-on-gaza-border-israeli-military-says (''The Guardian'')]
**Israeli forces arrest two [[Palestinians]] who are suspected of having killed an Israeli soldier. [https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Four-Palestinians-arrested-in-connection-with-the-murder-of-Dvir-Sorek-598229 (''Jerusalem Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*The death toll due to the [[monsoon]] flooding in southern and western [[India]] rises to 147, while hundreds of thousands have been evacuated from their homes. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/death-toll-indian-floods-reaches-147-thousands-evacuated-190811134634886.html (Al Jazeera)]
*At least 56 people have been killed and more than a million forced from their homes as [[Typhoon Lekima (2019)|Typhoon Lekima]] hits eastern [[China]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-49340742 (BBC News)]
*[[Morogoro tanker explosion]]
**At least 75 people have been killed and 60 injured in a [[fuel tanker]] explosion in [[Morogoro]], [[Tanzania]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-08/12/c_138304087.htm (Xinhua)]
*Five people are confirmed dead and three injured following an accidental [[rocket]] explosion on a naval test range near [[Severodvinsk]], [[Russia]] on Thursday August 8th. The rocket used an experimental [[Nuclear physics|nuclear]] [[isotope]] liquid fuel source, causing a brief localized spike in [[radiation]]. 9500 nearby residents were evacuated. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-49301438 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**In a letter sent by [[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] to [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], Kim apologizes for the testing of short-range missiles. Trump says he expects to meet Kim soon and see a denuclearized North Korea as "one of the most successful countries in the world". [https://www.clarin.com/mundo/donald-trump-dice-lider-norcoreano-pidio-perdon-pruebas-misiles_0_Bf_Xdnkye.html (''Clarín'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Death of Jeffrey Epstein]]
**American financier [[Jeffrey Epstein]] is found dead in his [[Manhattan]] jail cell in an apparent [[Suicide in the United States|suicide]] while awaiting trial for sex trafficking charges. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/10/nyregion/jeffrey-epstein-suicide.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Moscow City Duma election]]
**As many as 50,000 people gathered at ongoing protests in [[Moscow]] against the [[Russia]]n authorities preventing several opposition candidates from running in the election, which turned into a protest against the government in general. It is the biggest such event since the [[2011 Russian protests|2011 protests]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/1000s-gather-moscow-election-protest-64897600 (ABC News)]
